items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Wasn't it Billy Kinsall or something like that? [INTERVIEWEE] I forgot the name of the band, but she didn't have enough--she wanted to augment it, so Swazey and I augmented the band.
